messages:
nate: Morning team — prepping region-by-region push for v3.2.0. Plan: US canary -> EU -> APAC. Need capacity thumbs + warm pool numbers. ETA ~30m for first canary. @mei @sam
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Scheduled: v3.2.0 canary -> us-canary-1 (10% traffic). Started by nate. PID 9834.
mei: Confirming dedicated warm pool of 24 GPUs in US, reserved for canary + ~10% cushion. Will keep 6 GPUs hot for quick backfill.
sam: Runbook note: set version-pin for us endpoints to v3.2.0 during canary. Rollback trigger: 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m or p95 latency increase > 40% baseline.
luis: Fyi saw elevated 95th lat in us-east-2 yesterday (peaked 180ms). Suggest starting slow: keep canary at 10% for 15m minimum before any bump.
sre-ops: I'll tail infra metrics and pre-provision a hotfix pool in eu-west-1 for immediate backfill. Enabling deploy-bot fallback policy -> auto-deploy v3.1.4 on critical failure.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary health checks active. Next automated check in 5m. Sending perf and error hooks to #release-1713456789-monitor.
mei: Quick capacity check (local): `./tools/cap-check --region us-east-2 --model default --qps 500` -> healthy. reserved_capacity=26 GPUs, headroom=15%.
nate: Good. Holdpoint at +15m from now. If clean, bump US to 50% and start EU canary at 10% (pin EU to v3.2.0 during canary). Keep release-notes updated with any caveats.
sam: Release-note draft: "v3.2.0 — kernel scheduling fix + batching perf. Rolling US -> EU -> APAC. Canary pins and automatic fallback to v3.1.4." Will paste to console changelog shortly.
luis: APAC plan: warm 8 GPUs in ap-southeast-1 before starting; if memory OOMs occur, fallback target = v3.1.4-q8 (quantized).
nate: Also add thermal override: if GPU temp > 85C for 10m -> scale down and trigger rollback. Manual override allowed from SRE lead.
sre-ops: Noted. Creating incident channel and adding oncall. Channel: #release-1713456789-monitor (auto-created). Adding me, mei, sam. Anyone else?
mei: I'll be oncall for the first hour.
sam: I'll handle external comms if we expand the rollout.
nate: Ok launching now. @deploy-bot please kick the canary.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary started: us-canary-1 @10% traffic. Health: collecting metrics.
mei: :white_check_mark: initial smoke pass — p95=120ms, error_rate=0.0%. No OOMs.
nate: Holdpoint reached. No red flags from infra or product. Proceed: promote US to 50% and start EU canary at 10% with slow ramp.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promoting us-canary-1 -> us-slice-50pct. Starting eu-canary-1 @10%.
sre-ops: EU capacity quick-check: reserved=18 GPUs, headroom=8%. Starting EU canary with conservative ramp: +5% every 3m.
luis: Warming APAC pool now: 8 GPUs warming in ap-southeast-1. ETA ~20m.
sam: Release notes updated and linked in Console changelog (internal link pasted).
mei: All green on US & EU so far. I'll post hourly updates to #release-1713456789-monitor.
nate: Thanks everyone. Reminder: fallback policy = immediate pin to v3.1.4 + open incident if any critical metric trips. I'll stay around for the first two hours.
